decision_context.rationale: decide-investment and manage-investment-lifecycle restore exact Decision revisions; operate-investment-program reads current Action Cards, validity, blockers, alternatives and the manual execution boundary.

investment_action_plan.rationale: decide-investment and manage-investment-lifecycle use deterministic portfolio and execution inputs for standard sizing or the separately qualified bounded lane; neither asks Risk Gate to judge the Thesis.

investment_action_update.rationale: operate-investment-program enqueues only active actionable Opportunities and records presentation or an explicitly referenced user accept, reject or snooze response; manage-investment-lifecycle relies on acceptance remaining separate from Execution and Ledger.

investment_decision_publish.rationale: decide-investment and manage-investment-lifecycle publish one time-bounded Decision with exact Thesis, Evidence, Context, Portfolio, alternatives and invalidators; action variants additionally require a matching eligible Research Validation and passing Risk Gate.

investment_evidence_update.rationale: research-investment freezes every material source with type, lineage and event timing; decide-investment freezes the market observations used at decision time. Neither workflow treats Evidence as a Decision or trade.

investment_opportunity_update.rationale: operate-investment-program creates research questions, advances Opportunities one stage at a time, claims persistent Research Work, explicitly dispositions every frozen candidate, and completes full research as promoted, rejected or time-bounded monitoring.

investment_research_publish.rationale: research-investment publishes one immutable Thesis revision from exact Evidence Manifest IDs and a knowledge cutoff, and reads the optional formal Validation without treating eligibility as an Investment Decision.

research_context.rationale: research-investment restores ResearchRecord and formal Validation; operate-investment-program reads selected and queued Research Work; manage-investment-companion inspects research_ready results; decide-investment reads only qualified research state.

investment_context_update.rationale: manage-investment-lifecycle drafts Investor, Mandate and Attention revisions, shows them to the user, then activates only the referenced revision after confirmation.

investment_home.rationale: Investment Home must distinguish system degradation from a valid no-action conclusion before any investment workflow proceeds.

investment_transaction_update.rationale: manage-investment-lifecycle uses every listed operation to maintain account identity, pending and confirmed facts, immutable reversals, reconciliation and manual continuity; decide-investment uses continuity qualification before exact sizing.

portfolio_context.rationale: manage-investment-lifecycle reads confirmed portfolio truth, pending facts and precision qualification; decide-investment and operate-investment-program read only the subset needed for decisions and setup.
